scripts.db:migrate: cd apps/api && source .venv/bin/activate && PYTHONPATH=src alembic upgrade head
scripts.db:revision: cd apps/api && source .venv/bin/activate && PYTHONPATH=src alembic revision --autogenerate
scripts.db:test: cd apps/api && source .venv/bin/activate && PYTHONPATH=src pytest tests/test_postgres_smoke.py -v
scripts.db:validate: cd apps/api && source .venv/bin/activate && PYTHONPATH=src python scripts/validate_postgres_modules.py
scripts.validate:e2e: cd apps/api && source .venv/bin/activate && PYTHONPATH=src python scripts/run_e2e_validation.py
scripts.validate:e2e:reports: cd apps/api && source .venv/bin/activate && PYTHONPATH=src python scripts/run_e2e_validation.py --write-files
scripts.db:seed: cd apps/api && source .venv/bin/activate && PYTHONPATH=src python scripts/seed_local_dev.py
scripts.docker:up:routing: docker compose -f infrastructure/docker/docker-compose.yml --profile core --profile routing up -d
scripts.docker:down: docker compose -f infrastructure/docker/docker-compose.yml --profile core --profile routing --profile fleetbase down
scripts.docker:fleetbase:up: cd apps/fleetbase && docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.override.yml -f ../../infrastructure/docker/fleetbase.porterchain.override.yml up -d
scripts.docker:fleetbase:down: cd apps/fleetbase && docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.override.yml -f ../../infrastructure/docker/fleetbase.porterchain.override.yml down
scripts.docker:fleetbase:logs: cd apps/fleetbase && docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.override.yml -f ../../infrastructure/docker/fleetbase.porterchain.override.yml logs -f
